test_intent.behavior: Normalize and persist bounded, provenance-bound OpenRouter catalog snapshots.
test_intent.expected_signal: Both provider responses and repository captures stop at the decoded-byte cap.

test_intent.behavior: Produce deterministic shortlists with exact projected dollar costs.
test_intent.expected_signal: Per-million prices are converted to dollars before reporting and compatible models retain deterministic ordering.

test_intent.behavior: Replay immutable snapshots and keep future-task fixtures isolated.
test_intent.expected_signal: Stored inputs replay identically only with canonical, temporally compatible provenance, and temporary task fixtures cannot leak accepted state.

red_evidence.summary: Reviews identified self-authorization, unbounded ingestion, replay, and duration, missing compatibility checks, incorrect cost scaling, forged, missing, or future freshness, partial, non-atomic, misordered, or concurrency-ambiguous refresh persistence, uncanceled rejected bodies, unsafe store paths, forged snapshot identity, and incomplete capability and duplicate-ID handling; each was corrected before this candidate.

green_evidence.summary: The exact candidate passed the full repository gate with 169 tests.
The exact candidate passed all deterministic contract and adversarial tests.
The exact candidate passed all 9 offline catalog scenarios.

independent_validation.notes: Remote latest-head CI and Codex review remain required shipping gates.

test_first_skipped_reason.reason: Current-head review supplied concrete failing scenarios before each final correctness and provenance repair.

anti_fitting_notes: The captured-file test uses a sparse file above the cap and exercises the real CLI ingestion path.
Exact cost assertions prove conversion from per-million prices while retaining deterministic ordering.
The provider stream test omits Content-Length and proves cancellation at the decoded-byte cap.
The context test uses a cheaper incompatible model that would otherwise displace an evaluable candidate.
The live test pins the process clock and proves caller input cannot forge freshness.
The storage test preseeds valid same-digest artifacts with forged source, identity, and future timestamps.
All repository JSON and source reads share a byte-limited streaming reader.
Replay rejects schema-valid snapshots whose source or digest-derived identity is noncanonical.
Duplicate IDs are retained only when every row normalizes identically; conflicting or partially invalid groups are excluded.
Repository captures without an explicit acquisition timestamp are rejected before file ingestion.
Refresh persistence proves an observation conflict cannot publish a snapshot and a snapshot-write failure removes its new observation.
Captured timestamps beyond the five-minute skew allowance are rejected before fetching or persistence.
Real filesystem tests prove symlinked snapshot and observation directories cannot redirect files outside the store.
Tool-choice-only metadata is incompatible with call sites that require tool definitions.
Fake-clock tests prove both stalled headers and stalled bodies abort at the shared deadline and record failure evidence.
Snapshot and observation persistence publish complete same-directory temporary files atomically and never overwrite immutable identities.
A real concurrent FileCatalogStore test proves per-digest serialization records exactly one new snapshot and one reused snapshot across competing refreshes.
A paused snapshot writer proves successful observation evidence is not visible until the referenced snapshot publishes.
Replay rejects future-edited snapshot freshness and binds a matching successful observation ID and time while allowing later observations of unchanged content.
A rejected streaming response proves the body is canceled before failure evidence returns.
residual_risks: Live OpenRouter transport remains intentionally outside offline CI.
Windows-specific filesystem behavior is outside the current V1 matrix.

integrated_validation.scope_summary: The whole repository and offline scenarios passed on the exact implementation candidate; remote gates remain pending.
